crc_parameters.data_crc: CRC16-CCITT (x^16+x^12+x^5+1) per DAT line per block

opcode_synthesis_skipped_reason: L2.protocol_overview.half_duplex is not True and no explicit opcode/command-table heading was found in input/docs/. Free-form hex bytes in prose, SVG labels, or PDF text do not constitute opcode evidence.
command_format: start(1) + transmission(1) + command index(6) + argument(32) + CRC7(7) + end(1)

commands.name: GO_IDLE_STATE
commands.note: reset to Idle; arg 0xF0F0F0F0/0xFFFFFFFA = boot modes

commands.name: SEND_OP_COND
commands.note: send/poll OCR (voltage + busy + access mode); eMMC uses CMD1, NOT the SD application command ACMD41

commands.name: SWITCH
commands.note: write one Extended CSD byte (bus width, HS_TIMING, PARTITION_CONFIG, ...)

commands.name: SEND_EXT_CSD
commands.note: read the 512-byte Extended CSD (eMMC redefines CMD8; SD CMD8 is SEND_IF_COND)

commands.name: SEND_STATUS
commands.note: read device status (and queue status in CMDQ mode)

commands.name: SET_BLOCK_COUNT
commands.note: predefined count + Reliable Write + Context ID + Packed flag

commands.name: ERASE
commands.note: erase / TRIM / Discard / Secure Erase / Sanitize per argument

commands.name: CMDQ_TASK_MGMT
commands.note: discard a queued task / the whole queue

boot_operation.boot_mode: host holds CMD low >= 74 CLK cycles (or boot ack) to stream BOOT_CONFIG boot partition before identification
